title: Conditional Branching with @if and @else
ques: Write a Sass mixin `theme-variant` that uses **`@if`**, **`@else if`**, and **`@else`** to apply distinct text and background colors based on a `$mode` argument ('light', 'dark', or 'high-contrast').
explanation: Control directives `@if`, `@else if`, and `@else` permit conditional logic in stylesheets, adjusting styles based on parameters or theme configurations.

title: Iterating Over Maps with @each
ques: Demonstrate the use of the **`@each`** loop to iterate over a map of brand colors (`$social-colors`) and dynamically output custom button modifier classes.
explanation: The `@each` loop iterates over lists or key-value maps, generating structured repetitive class suites automatically.

title: Generating Sequences with @for Loops
ques: Explain the difference between `@for $i from 1 through 3` and `@for $i from 1 to 3`. Write an SCSS snippet generating column width classes from 1 through 4.
explanation: `through` is inclusive of the upper boundary, whereas `to` is exclusive. `@for` loops are standard for generating numbered utility scales (grids, z-index, spacing).

title: Dynamic State Evaluation with @while
ques: Write a demonstration of the **`@while`** loop in Sass that halves an initial pixel size until a minimum threshold is reached, generating typographic heading scale steps.
explanation: `@while` repeatedly executes a code block until its conditional statement evaluates to `false`. Ensure state variables mutate inside the loop to avoid infinite compilation loops.

title: Compiler Diagnostics: @error, @warn, and @debug
ques: Explain the differences between **`@debug`**, **`@warn`**, and **`@error`**. Write a mixin `set-grid-gap` that throws an `@error` if an invalid unit is provided.
explanation: `@debug` prints inspection values, `@warn` logs non-fatal advisories, and `@error` immediately halts compilation when critical constraints are violated.
